change.runContract: Each evaluation run now names a distinct UUID agent_run.id; duplicates are rejected before scoring.
change.readOnlyVerifier: The verifier reads tenant-scoped agent_run and agent_tool_call rows and compares persisted user_id, original content, ordered knowledgeScope, main-agent execution kind, answer model, terminal status, reply, and completed main_model journal rows with the frozen case and submitted run. Completed runs require a model call; failed runs may have failed before model invocation.
change.scoringGate: The independent scoring CLI now performs the same database binding for every completed or failed run before scoring. Unknown runs are unverified and already block the quality gate.
change.output: A local JSON summary of verified run IDs, persisted task hashes, and model-call IDs; no question or answer text is printed.

checks.targetedTests: 17 passed across independent-comparison and persisted-run-binding tests
negativeCases: missing model call for a completed run
checks.failedRunCase: A persisted failed task with no model call is accepted as a failed execution record, while scoring still blocks the quality gate.
